title: Coefficients of the normalized Fourier transform
statement: For any $n\ge 0$ and any function $p:\{\pm1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, the numerical coefficient function of $x\mapsto (1-p(\operatorname{sign}(x)))/2$ has, at each coordinate subset $T$, the value $\displaystyle \frac{\mathbf{1}_{\{T=\varnothing\}}-(-2)^{|T|}\sum_{S\supseteq T}\widehat p(S)}{2}$, where $\widehat p(S)$ is the uniform Fourier coefficient of $p$ at $S$.
